subject.title: fix(codex): fail closed on unknown projector statuses and warn on protocol drift

question: After the plan-correlation repair, should OpenClaw accept explicit unknown Codex item statuses as failed by default?
rationale: The remaining code repair is mechanical, but the intended fail-closed status behavior changes future Codex protocol drift from possible false success to possible interruption, which is a maintainer-owned compatibility decision.

options.title: Accept fail-closed after repair
options.body: Fix plan correlation, keep explicit unknown statuses failed with warnings, and merge once focused proof and CI are clean.

options.title: Prefer compatibility first
options.body: Warn on explicit unknown statuses but preserve non-failed projection until maintainers define a separate compatibility policy.

options.title: Pick another canonical branch
options.body: Pause this branch and move the linked issue to a sibling implementation if maintainers prefer that code shape or proof.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed after repair
recommendation.body: Fix plan correlation, keep explicit unknown statuses failed with warnings, and merge once focused proof and CI are clean.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Codex projector maintenance and broader app-server history make this the best available owner for the compatibility tradeoff.
